clue.text: Soldier to slip up in bank

indicators.note: the phrase for slipping up is placed in the middle of the word for a bank

parts.note: a tier is a bank or row, as of seats
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: A soldier loses footing and tumbles on a riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: A terrier is British slang for a member of the Territorial Army, the part-time reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British term for a volunteer reservist in the Territorial Army.

clue.text: Force hospital into consortium

indicators.note: the hospital letter goes inside the word for consortium

parts.note: a trust is a combination of companies

explanation.surface: A hospital is pushed into a business group.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrust is a forceful push, a synonym of force.

clue.text: Mass meeting about drug? Indeed!

indicators.note: the word for a mass meeting goes around the drug letter

parts.note: a rally is a large public gathering
E is ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone is amazed that a rally concerns drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are exclamations of surprise or emphasis, used as synonyms.

clue.text: Allude to touring Idaho for cow

indicators.note: the hint word travels around the state abbreviation

parts.note: to intimate is to hint at
ID is the postal abbreviation for Idaho

explanation.surface: Someone mentions a cow on a trip around Idaho.
explanation.walkthrough: Cow looks like the farm animal but is the verb meaning to bully.
explanation.definitionFit: To cow someone is to frighten them into submission, the same as browbeat.

clue.text: Rent regularly taken in Yorkshire city

parts.note: a rip is a tear or rent
on, as of medicine one is on, meaning taken routinely

explanation.surface: Rent is collected regularly in a northern city.
explanation.walkthrough: Rent looks like money paid but is a tear; regularly looks like an alternate-letters signal but pairs with taken to mean on.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cathedral city in North Yorkshire, England.

clue.text: Soldier sits or lies down

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for soldiers in crosswords
to sit for a portrait is to pose, so sits gives poses

explanation.surface: A soldier at ease either sits or lies down.
explanation.definitionFit: To repose is to rest lying flat, the same as reclining.

clue.text: Hit the roof, as Adam did

definitions.meaning: to explode with anger and make a fuss
Adam fathered and brought up Cain in Genesis

explanation.surface: Someone flies into a rage as the first man once did.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means cause uproar; literally Adam reared his son Cain.

clue.text: Pundit initially put down performance

indicators.note: just the opening letter of pundit is used

parts.note: to lay is to put down

explanation.surface: A critic puts down a show at the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: A play is a staged dramatic performance.

clue.text: Duly ends assembly without warning

indicators.note: the letters are assembled into a new order

explanation.surface: A school assembly finishes on time as expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening without warning happens abruptly, all at once.

clue.text: Firm adopting advertising is showing incredulity

indicators.note: the firm word takes in the other letters

parts.note: sure means firm, steady
PR, public relations, stands for advertising

explanation.surface: A company taking on advertising looks disbelieving.
explanation.definitionFit: Astonishment at something unexpected is close to disbelief.

clue.text: Criticise a society involved in corruption

indicators.note: the letters for a and society are set inside the word for corruption

parts.note: rot is decay or moral corruption

explanation.surface: Someone attacks a club caught up in a scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: To roast someone is to criticise them severely, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Briefly prince and his queen play around

indicators.note: the name of the prince is cut short, losing its final letters

parts.note: Prince Philip, consort of Elizabeth II
ER, Elizabeth Regina, was Philip's queen

explanation.surface: A royal couple are accused of infidelity.
explanation.walkthrough: Briefly trims PHILIP to PHIL; the surface invites thinking of royal scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: To philander is to have casual affairs, which is what playing around means.

clue.text: Priest introduced to smoother amphibian

indicators.note: the priest's title is put into the middle of the word for a smoother

parts.note: a sander is a tool that smooths wood
a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist priest

explanation.surface: A cleric meets a woodworking tool and a newt-like creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The salamander is a tailed amphibian related to newts.

clue.text: Tight-fisted? Not far off!

definitions.meaning: mean with money, a dated British sense of the word

explanation.surface: A stingy person is close at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both stingy (as in near with money) and close in distance.

clue.text: Ned resents contrived affection

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Ned dislikes a show of fondness that is put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Warm gentleness and fondness are kinds of affection.

clue.text: Dodgy dealers land in war zone

indicators.note: dodgy means unsound or crooked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Crooked traders turn up in a combat area.
explanation.walkthrough: Dodgy rearranges DEALERS and LAND together; the strait was the scene of the Gallipoli campaign of 1915.
explanation.definitionFit: The Turkish strait was a First World War battleground during the Gallipoli campaign.

clue.text: Facility to see above one's head

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the rest

parts.note: to read is to see or understand, as in I read you
I is the Roman numeral one
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: A facility lets you look over someone's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Facility means ease or willingness, and readiness is prompt ease of doing.

clue.text: Stress keeping identification in disaster

indicators.note: the stress word holds the abbreviation inside

parts.note: an accent is a stress on a syllable

explanation.surface: Stress from carrying papers leads to calamity.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap or crash causing harm is a kind of disaster.

clue.text: Oedipus's daughter is against Greek individual

parts.note: anti means opposed
G is an abbreviation for Greek
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: The king's daughter opposes a single Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: In Sophocles, she is the child of Oedipus and Jocasta.

clue.text: Reticent prisoner pushed to the limit

parts.note: con is short for convict
strained means stretched to breaking point

explanation.surface: A quiet inmate is under great stress.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone held back and restrained in manner is reticent, reserved.

clue.text: Calm, having had drinks in A&E

indicators.note: the drinks go inside A and E

parts.note: A&E is the British hospital accident and emergency department
teas are drinks

explanation.surface: Someone sits relaxed after drinks in casualty.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E is the British hospital emergency department; having had looks like ATE but is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being relaxed and untroubled is the same as being calm.

clue.text: Tedious study of poet

parts.note: dry means dull or tedious
a den is a study or private room

explanation.surface: A boring examination of a writer of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: John Dryden was the seventeenth-century English Poet Laureate.

clue.text: Irish leader twice gets the bird

indicators.note: the leading letter of Irish is taken

parts.note: bis is Latin for twice, used in music for a repeat

explanation.surface: An Irish politician is jeered off stage twice.
explanation.walkthrough: Getting the bird means being booed, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibis is a long-legged wading bird with a curved bill.

clue.text: Graphic artist uses wire and string

indicators.note: the letters are put to a new use, rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: An artist works with wire and string in their creations.
explanation.walkthrough: Uses signals rearranging WIRE and STRING together, with and as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who paints shop signs and lettering is a kind of graphic artist.

clue.text: Letter on top of desk is prominent

indicators.note: in a down clue the letter sits above the next piece

parts.note: a note is a short letter

indicators.note: the first letter of desk is taken

explanation.surface: A letter sits on top of a desk in plain view.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well known and distinguished is prominent, eminent.

clue.text: Canteen stew

definitions.meaning: a confused or jumbled state, or a dish of mixed food

explanation.surface: A canteen serves stew.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a forces dining hall and also a muddle or hotchpotch.

clue.text: Fugitive union member has internal operation

indicators.note: the word for member holds the abbreviation inside it

parts.note: an element is a member or component part

explanation.surface: A union member undergoes surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: Fugitive union looks like a trade union matter but describes runaway lovers marrying.
explanation.definitionFit: Running away secretly to marry is a union entered into on the run.

clue.text: Fast runner in dash to end of road

parts.note: elan means flair or dash

indicators.note: only the final letter of road is taken

explanation.surface: A sprinter makes a dash to the end of the road.
explanation.definitionFit: This African antelope can run at speed, so it is a fast runner.

clue.text: Article's about first believers

indicators.note: the article plus its s goes around the ordinal

parts.note: the definite article the, with s from the apostrophe s
1st, read as IST

explanation.surface: An article concerns the earliest people of faith.
explanation.definitionFit: People who hold faith in a god are believers.

clue.text: Notice director is with nuclear researchers

parts.note: CERN is the European nuclear research centre near Geneva

explanation.surface: A director spends time with physicists.
explanation.definitionFit: To discern is to perceive or spot, a synonym of notice.
